chunks.rationale: This merge joins two independent T3 ports: the flat sidebar (this branch, #587) and the native/portal thread-actions menu (main, #592). Resolution keeps the flat structure and moves ALL card menus onto the #592 path: ThreadCard's openThreadMenu/applyMenuId call showContextMenu (Electron Menu.popup on Desktop, position:fixed body portal elsewhere); the in-card snooze and overflow HTML dropdowns are gone. Pin was added to buildThreadActionMenuItems (showPin, data-pin-item) since the flat sidebar had put it in the now-deleted HTML overflow.
risks: The '…' render gate now includes onSetSnoozed (matches main) — a card with only snooze wiring still gets the menu.
menuBusy ref serializes menu opens; a second click while the native menu is up is a no-op, matching main's behavior.
jsdom tests exercise only the HTML fallback; a native Menu.popup regression would not fail the renderer suite (electron/test/contextMenu.test.js covers the main-process side, 2/2).

chunks.rationale: src/components/Sidebar.tsx: ThreadCard lost snoozeMenuOpen/moreMenuOpen/onToggleMoreMenu props (Kanban unaffected — props were optional); right-click on a card opens the same menu; hover clock = presets portal or instant wake when snoozed; hover check = settle; data-sidebar-list added for the portal containment test. Parent dropped snoozeMenuFor/moreMenuFor state — the portal dismisses itself. Header scope/create menus keep the old HTML dropdown path (pre-existing clipping risk, unchanged by this merge).
risks: The header scope/create menus still render position:absolute inside the sidebar — same clipping class of bug #592 fixed for cards. Follow-up, not this diff.

chunks.rationale: Conflicted suites resolved onto flat selectors + portal queries: menu items are found via document.querySelector('[data-context-menu] …') because m.query only sees the mount container; afterEach dismissContextMenu() in sidebar/forkHandoff/pinSnooze prevents portal leakage between tests. Main's #582/#583 blocks (body portal, snooze flyout submenu, right-click, keyboard nav) were grafted into the flat suite; ArrowDown expectation updated for the Pin item between Snooze and Fork. 1257/1257.
risks: prRender's pin assertion moved from static markup to buildThreadActionMenuItems — the render-level guarantee is now indirect (the click path is covered in sidebar.test.tsx).

chunks.rationale: .solenta/specs/t3-flat-sidebar.md still describes the in-card overflow menu; #592 superseded that section — the selector names survive but live in the portal.

risks: First launch remains the visual check for the combined result (no screenshot tooling in this session).
Electron suite baseline failures (#536) are unrelated; no electron/ files changed beyond what main brought in.
